meta.title: Grabbit — free YouTube video & audio downloader
meta.description: Grabbit is a free, open-source desktop app for downloading YouTube videos, playlists and audio, built on yt-dlp. For macOS, Windows and Linux.
meta.ogDescription: Paste a YouTube link, choose video or audio and a quality, and download. Free and open source, for macOS, Windows and Linux.
hero.title_html:
Download YouTube videos and audio.
Nothing else in the way.
hero.lede: Grabbit is a free, open-source desktop app for saving YouTube videos, playlists and channels to your computer. Paste a YouTube link, pick video or audio and a quality, and download.
hero.builtOn: Built on yt-dlp, so hundreds of other video sites work too.
shot.label: Screenshot
shot.alt: Grabbit with a video link fetched, showing video or audio, quality, format, subtitle and save-location options
features.title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
features.mode.title: Video or audio
features.mode.body: Save a YouTube video as MP4 that plays everywhere or MKV with the best codecs. Or keep just the audio as MP3 or M4A.
features.quality.title: Real quality options
features.quality.body: The picker lists the resolutions each YouTube video actually has. No guessing.
features.queue.title: Download queue
features.queue.body: Several downloads at once, with live progress, cancel and retry.
features.playlists.title: YouTube playlists and channels
features.playlists.body: Paste a playlist or channel link, see every video and choose which ones to grab. Each playlist gets its own folder.
features.subtitles.title: Subtitles and metadata
features.subtitles.body: Embed YouTube subtitles (uploaded or auto-generated), title, thumbnail and chapters straight into the file.
features.update.title: Fixes itself
features.update.body: When a YouTube change breaks downloads, update the yt-dlp engine from inside the app. No new release needed.
download.title: Download
download.macHint: M1 or newer? Choose Apple Silicon.
firstRun.title: Opening Grabbit the first time
firstRun.lede: Grabbit isn't signed with a paid developer certificate yet, so your system asks you to confirm once.
firstRun.mac_html: Open the .dmg and drag Grabbit to Applications. When you see “Apple could not verify Grabbit”, click Done. Then open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.
firstRun.windows_html: If SmartScreen says “Windows protected your PC”, click More info, then Run anyway.
firstRun.linux_html: Install the .deb or .rpm with your package manager. For the AppImage, run chmod +x on it, then open it.
footer.license: Grabbit is free and open source under the MIT license.
footer.disclaimer: Download only content you have the right to. Grabbit is not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
